stance_rationale: The draft is not just optimizing fixed inputs: it rewrites the alpha weight-schedule policy into M4 while claiming no alpha modification, and the resulting sleeve weights breach the base QEPM 20% per-name hard constraint absent a formal look-through waiver. Walk-forward coverage exists, but cost, infeasibility, method-shopping, and admission checks are not audit-clean.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: M4_TRADE_WAR_FIX selected after 5 named methods plus disclosed M3 90-grid and M4 50-grid searches; strong_p=0.30 is justified by theoretical anchor although full-sample SR rises through 0.50.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: FAIL: optimizer reports about 4.42-4.67 bps/year using one side; role prompt formula turnover x 15bps x 2 gives about 8.87 bps/year, close to risk package S3 cost 8.67 bps/year.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O6: schedule max_w=1.0 and current STR_1715 sleeve weight=0.7349 exceed base [0,0.20] per-name bound unless a formal sleeve look-through waiver is approved.
RF-O8: risk artifacts show CVaR_95 S3=10.22% versus template cap 2.5%; governance rebuttal exists, but optimizer issued no infeasibility_report or alternate cap approval.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: MISSING: no MEGA_05/PG2 active-book TDC<0.30, replacement-vs-integration split, or 80/20 blended SR/MDD/IR report.

critical_concerns.description: Raw schedule has max weight 1.0 and target STR_1715 sleeve weight 0.7349, so RF-O6 fails under the base QEPM [0,0.20] per-name hard constraint; the package relies on an unapproved meta-allocation exemption rather than providing look-through constituent weights.

Optimizer changes the alpha itself: Alpha's S3 weight-schedule alpha is replaced by M4, dropping decay_strong-only signals and deepening extreme cash protection; for a WT where alpha_vector_type is a weight schedule, this is not a pure optimizer function.

Method-shopping count is understated: candidates_tried=5 ignores disclosed 90+50 grid combinations, and selection uses full-sample cost-adjusted SR while train has only one extreme firing and cannot discriminate.

RF-O2 fails: expected_information_ratio is only 0.1831 below the 0.3 threshold, M4 vs S2 NW t=0.852 is not significant, and optimizer cost is undercounted by using one-way rather than round-trip turnover cost.
RF-O8 is unresolved: risk-side CVaR_95=10.22% is marked a default-cap breach, but optimizer has infeasibility_report=null and no formal alternate cap or Governor approval.

weights.csv is a wide Date x weight_str1715 x weight_cash file, not the required as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected schema; the user-requested top-level weights.csv is absent and covariance.parquet is absent from both requested stage_artifacts mirror directories.
Sequential Admission is missing: no PG2/MEGA_05 TDC, no replacement-vs-integration scenario, no blended 80/20 metrics, and no beta_port target audit are provided.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv has 267 monthly rows from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, sums to 1 within 1.1e-15, and is long-only.
Turnover from the verified schedule is about 29.56% annualized half-turnover, safely below the 600% hard fail.
mailbox covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 5.505e-05 and condition number 87.46, so the covariance artifact itself clears the post-shrink condition check.
alpha_scores.parquet exists in the requested A/B alpha paths and has 267 rows, but it has no Ticker column because it is a sleeve-level meta-allocation artifact.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the WT request's [0,1] sleeve bound can override the base QEPM [0,0.20] per-name hard constraint without a formal look-through waiver.
Whether M4 is an optimizer output or an alpha re-specification requiring Alpha-stage re-approval.
Whether CVaR_95=10.22% has an approved cap exemption or still requires RF-O8 infeasibility handling.
Whether method-shopping cap counts named methods only or all protection/grid combinations.
Whether PG2 admission can proceed without active-book TDC and integration-scenario evidence.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the optimizer may rewrite a weight-schedule alpha into M4 and still claim AX-002 pure-function compliance because the trigger inputs were inherited.
rebuttal_required: Provide look-through STR_1715 constituent weights for every date or a formal governance waiver for sleeve-level [0,1] bounds.
Send M4 back through Alpha/Risk as a new alpha schedule or prove it is a deterministic optimizer transformation of fixed alpha and fixed Σ.
Recompute cost using turnover x 15bps x 2 and restate net_IR after the corrected cost model.
Issue an optimizer_challenge_note.md and infeasibility_report for CVaR/constraint exceptions, or document approved alternate caps.
Report true candidate count including all grids and recompute DSR/selection audit on that basis.
Add schema-compliant long weights file with as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected, or formalize the meta-allocation schema exception.
Provide PG2 active-book TDC, beta drift, replacement and integration scenario metrics before Forge/Judge handoff.
rationalization_red_flags: negligible vs STR_1715 base 280%/yr underlying turnover
avoid over-tuning despite higher SR available

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Covariance conditioning and monthly schedule existence are real positives, but Alpha is still CANDIDATE, prior Codex alpha/risk rounds were REJECT/REVISE-class, Forge is pending, and optimizer does not add a second independent PASS.

Why is estimated cost single-side when the role checklist requires turnover x 15bps x 2?
What approved risk cap replaces the 2.5% CVaR template, and why is infeasibility_report null?
